about.text: Buffalo mozzarella is a mozzarella made from the milk of the Italian Mediterranean buffalo. A fresh, soft pasta filata cheese, it is traditionally produced in Campania, particularly in the provinces of Caserta and Salerno.

how.text: Buffalo-milk curd soured with natural whey starter until it can stretch is spun in boiling water and torn into balls, giving thin overlapping layers that ooze a milky liquid; it is not ripened but sold fresh in its liquid.

steps.note: The curd is broken to walnut size, 3–6 cm.
Natural whey starter from previous buffalo-milk batches, and the curd is soured under whey until it can stretch.

steps.name: stretch
steps.note: Stretched in boiling water and torn off by hand into pieces of 10–800 g, plaits up to 3 kg.
